changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 6 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6310-designer-formula-key-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `designer.field.formula` (`'Formula (CEL)'`) in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, a different and live key belonging to metadata-admin's `ObjectFieldInspector` — the surface that still authors formula expressions.

### `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `table.noRows` (`'No rows to display'`) and `engine.form.noRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, read at `widgets.tsx`) — two different, same-named keys in different namespaces. Nor the comments in `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `PivotTable.tsx` that record WHY three widgets with three strings became one shared empty state; the packs' own comment keeps that rationale and now names the retirement instead of a row that is gone.

### `.changeset/7772-page-block-kanban-group-by-control.md`

- names `previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > Run against the node those four controls produced, `ObjectKanbanSchema.safeParse` reported **two** issues, not one: `groupBy` "expected string, received undefined", and `groupField` carrying the retirement guidance verbatim. So this panel could not author a valid `object-kanban` node however it was filled in, and the board it produced grouped nothing with no diagnostic on any face. Both halves are now pinned against the schema itself rather than against a spelling, in `previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` — `scripts/check-designer-field-key-parity.mjs` judges `PAYLOAD_SHAPES` and does not read `BLOCK_CONFIG`, so nothing mechanical was watching this table.

### `.changeset/8278-page-tabs-item-value.md`

- names `block-config.test.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > - `ComponentPropsMap['page:tabs'].safeParse` returns `success: false` with `unrecognized_keys` naming `key` at `items.0` — and 17.3.0's own message now spells the remedy out, "Did you mean `key` -> `value`?"; - `PageTabsRenderer` builds `itemsWithValue` from `it.value` and reads `it.key` nowhere, so the tab falls back to the index-derived `tab-IDX`; - `PageTabsProps.items[].value` is a real, declared schema member, which this repo's own `block-config.test.ts` already stated in prose.

- names `block-config.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` — edited by this change

  > The control is renamed to `value` on the producer side — AGENTS.md #0.1 and the rule stated in `block-config.ts`'s own file header ("keep each field `name` aligned with the property name the corresponding renderer reads"). Teaching the renderer a second spelling would have been the lenient-fallback shape that rule forbids. The field `name` is the last segment of the i18n key, so both locale tables move with it in this one commit and the retired key leaves both, the objectui#3829 / objectui#5212 pattern.

### `.changeset/8279-definition-list-term-description.md`

- names `block-config.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` — edited by this change

  > The controls are renamed to `term` / `description` — the producer side, per AGENTS.md #0.1 and the rule stated in `block-config.ts`'s own file header ("keep each field `name` aligned with the property name the corresponding renderer reads"). Two of the three faces already agreed: the block's registry declaration names `items` as "Term/description pairs `[{ term, description }]`". The designer was the outlier, so moving the renderer instead would have put it at odds with its own declaration.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `9419df198` (merge-base with origin/main): 5 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1804 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2414 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36718111390)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1d8257ab589d3bba93d69c94105f407b12249acb`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #11173 (body and all three comments: triage `5905811279`, claim `5910165461`, dev report `5911505335`); PR #11214 (body, the 6-file list, the net diff against `main` at `846cec0ef`); the check-runs on the head (`filter=latest`, polled until every run had completed: 43 at completion); context reads through `contents/PATH?ref=SHA` at base `846cec0ef` and at the head (`block-config.ts`, `i18n.ts`, `PageBlockInspector.tsx`, the three sibling suites, `app-shell/src/index.ts`, `app-shell/package.json`, `components/.../layout/containers.tsx`); PR objectui#10278's file list and diff for the region question only. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged — right.** No schema, prop, type or exported set moves. A stored `breadcrumb` is still accepted by the designer (it shows under Advanced and rides out on the next save, pinned on screen) and by the spec pin this PR leaves at `@objectstack/spec ^17.5.0` (app-shell `package.json` at base). `RETIRED_BLOCK_PROP_KEYS` at the head holds `'object-kanban': ['groupField']` only; the diff does not touch it, so the inspector strips nothing new. That is the triage ruling (`5905811279`: ADR-0087's load-time conversion is the one strip).
- **Public surface: one designer control leaves — right.** The Studio page designer's `page:header` panel no longer offers the "Show breadcrumb" checkbox. `BLOCK_CONFIG` and the metadata-admin `t()` table are not re-exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` (read at the head), so no package export, type or i18n pack moves. The en and zh rows of `engine.inspector.pageBlock.field.page:header.breadcrumb` leave together, so the two key sets stay identical (`Lint`, which carries `check:i18n-keys`, is green on the head).
- **The key was named only in `block-config.ts` and the two i18n rows outside tests, at base `846cec0ef` — right.** Read at base: `block-config.ts` carries one `breadcrumb` entry, in `BLOCK_CONFIG['page:header']`; `i18n.ts` carries the en row (`Show breadcrumb`) and the zh row (`显示面包屑`) of that label key. A code search of the repository for `page:header.breadcrumb` and a grep of the pre-PR tree in this container find no other non-test file; the only tests naming the toggle are the two this PR moves (`block-config.test.ts`'s field-set pin and `PageBlockInspector.i18n.test.tsx`'s zh label pair). The diff removes exactly those three source lines and nothing else in source.
- **Pins moved — right, and no coverage is lost.** The `icon` describe's positive half now reads `['title', 'subtitle']`, still non-vacuous for its own negative pin and for the new one. The new describe pins `not.toContain('breadcrumb')` behind the same length guard, and `t(key, locale)` returning the key in both locales, the shape the `icon` and `groupField` retirements use in the same file. In `PageBlockInspector.i18n.test.tsx`'s one-language case, the zh pair (`getByText('显示面包屑')`, `queryByText('Show breadcrumb')` null) leaves; the case still asserts two zh contents and one English absence, so "one language" is still a reading. The only coverage the old zh pair carried beyond that, a checkbox label resolving through `fieldLabel` in zh, is still pinned in the same file by `record:alert`'s `可关闭` (`dismissible`, a boolean field). `block-config-i18n.test.ts`'s ratchets do not move: the `field` family is a lower bound (`toBeGreaterThan(80)`), and the exact `add` (5) and `placeholder` (6) families never counted the toggle. Matches the dev's "assumption 3 did not hold".
- **New screen suite `PageBlockInspector.pageHeaderBreadcrumb-11173.test.tsx` — right.** Panel half, `it.each` over en-US and zh-CN: Title and Subtitle found by label (non-vacuity), `queryAllByRole('checkbox')` empty, neither label spelling on screen, no raw `engine.inspector.pageBlock.` text. Control half: a `PageSchema.parse`d page with `{ title: 'Account', breadcrumb: true }` opens with a checked checkbox labelled `breadcrumb` (the generic Advanced editor renders a boolean as `InspectorCheckboxField label={name}`), and a Title edit commits `{ title: 'Customer', breadcrumb: true }`.
  - **Would the control go red if a strip were added? Yes, judged from the code at the head.** In `PageBlockInspector.tsx`, `blockProps` is `stripRetiredBlockProps(block.type, block.properties)`, and it is the one value `advancedKeys` enumerates and `patchProp` spreads from. A `'page:header': ['breadcrumb']` entry removes the key from Advanced (the "opens" case's `getByLabelText('breadcrumb')` throws) and from the commit (the "saves" case's `toEqual` fails), and the existing `every registered key really is one the block schema refuses BY NAME` pin fails at `expect(type).toBe('object-kanban')`. That is exactly the three-failure shape the dev's ablation 2 reports; the reading here is of the code, not of the report. The fixture parses through `PageSchema`, which the sibling header measured does not judge block `properties`, so the control stays a reading about the inspector after a later spec pin tombstones the key.
- **`RETIRED_BLOCK_PROP_KEYS` gains no `page:header` entry — right** (head, the constant's one row), and the comment beside the removed entry says why the strip table stays untouched. The BY NAME pin still walks whatever the registry holds.
- **Region — right, disjoint from PR objectui#10278.** This PR's hunks in the shared files are the `page:header` entry of `block-config.ts` and, in `block-config.test.ts`, the `icon` describe's field-set pin plus a new describe inserted before `page:accordion`. PR #10278's hunks in those two files are `object-kanban` prose (`DEFAULT_KANBAN_LIMIT` to `DEFAULT_KANBAN_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE`) in the kanban entry and in the kanban describe; its other two app-shell files (`block-config-i18n.test.ts`, `PageBlockInspector.retiredBlockProps.test.tsx`) are not touched here, and `i18n.ts` and `PageBlockInspector.i18n.test.tsx` are not in #10278. No shared hunk.
- **Prose carried by the diff — right.** The notes beside the removed entry and beside each removed i18n row name #11173, #11166, objectstack#20758 and ADR-0087 and cite by content, not by line address; `Line Citation Gate` is green. No model identifier in the PR body, the changeset, the commits or the code.
- Judged wrong: none.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/11173-retire-page-header-breadcrumb-toggle.md` declares `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` — **right**. The diff edits published `src/` of a `fixed`-group package (`block-config.ts`, `i18n.ts`), so a declaration is owed and `skip-changeset` would be wrong; the test files owe none. `patch` is the level: a fix in a released package takes `patch`, and nothing an author can write is removed or renamed (the stored key is still accepted and round-trips; no export, type or config field moves), so it is not breaking and `minor` is not owed. Precedent: the `icon` retirement (objectui#3829, `183d09b`) sits under Patch Changes in the app-shell CHANGELOG. The body carries the from/to fact a reader needs (the toggle is gone, a stored key is not rewritten, the one strip is the spec's). `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report` and `Changeset Claim Re-read` are all success on the head.
- `Clause-②: no` — **right**, at the start of a line in the PR body and in claim `5910165461`, with no `(widening)`/`(narrowing)` arm. No accept set widens or narrows: a designer control leaves, the stored-metadata accept set and the spec pin are unchanged, and the designer round-trips a stored `breadcrumb` as before.
